description: This PHP file defines the 'Coupon' class within the OpenCart e-commerce platform. The class manages coupon-related functionalities such as calculating discounts, applying coupons to totals, confirming coupon usage, and removing coupon histories upon order unconfirmation.

classes.name: Coupon
classes.description: Handles coupon validation, application, and history management within the OpenCart platform.

methods.name: getTotal
methods.description: Calculates and applies coupon discounts to the cart totals, updating taxes and total amounts accordingly.

methods.name: confirm
methods.description: Validates a coupon code during order confirmation and records usage if valid.

methods.name: unconfirm
methods.description: Removes coupon usage history when an order is canceled or unconfirmed.
